first_reversal_outcome: ROA 3.4%a; margin returns near 2013 monthly average
trough_countervailing_component: financial margin +0.8pp to 10.1%a, mainly better securities results
credit_channel_role: family delinquency rises gradually, but incobrability charges remain ~0.8%a in Apr and do not explain the trough

trough_outcome: ROA around V31 strict-drawdown trough; margin falls 4.4pp to 13.9%a
trough_countervailing_component: lower interest expenses partly cushion; incobrability charges 1.4%a and elevated 12m
credit_channel_role: credit costs rise in H2 but are secondary to the November margin reversal as the proximate monthly driver
regulatory_channel_role: FX-position limits + reserve requirements alter balance/liquidity before drawdown

overshoot_supporting_components: 2023 margin 30.8% asset; securities +28.1; FX +8.0; CER +5.4; passes +9.1; interest income +13.0, offset by interest expense -32.9 and monetary result -14.1
trough_countervailing_component: lower interest expenses and lower monetary losses cushion part of the decline
credit_channel_role: material personal+cards delinquency acceleration comes only in early 2025, after the profitability drawdown
regulatory_channel_role: monetary framework and balance reallocation change instrument mix during Dec-23/2024
sources: BCRA Dec-2023, Mar-2024, Sep-2024 + V45 mora
